observation.answer:
`packages/tokens/src/theme/history.ts` is the pure undo/redo/commit history module — `commit` is what folds "Reset theme" into one undoable entry, and `undo` is what's supposed to restore the prior override. It's directly covered by the `reset restores the stock draft as one entry and undo returns the whole draft` test in `packages/tokens/src/__tests__/history.test.ts`, with the docs app's `theme-studio.test.tsx` covering the same scenario end-to-end.

OWNER: packages/tokens/src/theme/history.ts
COMMAND: pnpm --filter @ultima/tokens test -- src/__tests__/history.test.ts
